companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Buongiorno! I am Portia, the archway. A greeting and your name before entry, please. Come ti chiami?
lines.translation: Good morning! I am Portia, the archway. A greeting and your name before entry, please. What is your name?
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. Apparently, even entrances have paperwork.

lines.native: Ciao! Your greeting is accepted. Your name, however, remains conspicuously absent from the paperwork. Come ti chiami?
lines.translation: Hello! Your greeting is accepted. Your name, however, remains conspicuously absent from the paperwork. What is your name?
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. She ticks one box with the satisfaction of an institution making partial progress.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam! Your introduction is officially accepted. And my name? Courtesy is not a one-way street, even when one party is architecture.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam! Your introduction is officially accepted. And my name? Courtesy is not a one-way street, even when one party is architecture.
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam into the visitors’ book. Her pen hovers over a second column, apparently reserved for reciprocal courtesy.

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! You asked my name. How considerate. I am entirely composed; that is merely settling masonry. Benvenuto! Your manners are approved. You may enter.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! You asked my name. How considerate. I am entirely composed; that is merely settling masonry. Welcome! Your manners are approved. You may enter.
lines.narrative: Portia’s keystone clicks open. A visitors’ book stamps itself with the solemnity usually reserved for considerably less important paperwork.

objective_results.feedback: Introduce yourself using an Italian first-person expression and your name.
Ask Portia her name in Italian, or ask “and you?” using the Italian informal pronoun.
